description: This file contains helper methods for web page tested in functional tests, specifically for extracting tokens and IDs using regular expressions.

classes.name: WebPageHelpers
classes.description: A static helper class providing methods to extract tokens and IDs from HTML content in web functional tests.

methods.name: GetRequestVerificationToken
methods.description: Extracts the request verification token from HTML input string using regex.

methods.name: GetId
methods.description: Extracts the item ID from HTML input string using regex.

methods.name: RegexSearch
methods.description: Performs a regex match and returns the last captured group from the input string.
